description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'read-tree' functionality of git, specifically focusing on corner cases involving conflicts when reading tree objects. It sets up test repositories, makes trees, performs operations, and verifies correctness of index states post operations.

methods.name: maketree
methods.description: Creates a git tree object from provided file paths and tags it with a specified name.

methods.name: settree
methods.description: Sets up the working directory to match a specified tree object.

methods.name: checkindex
methods.description: Checks the current git index against expected file states.
